verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents domain-specific rules that act automatically on transaction events. A 3D Secure rule can force a challenge when an amount exceeds a threshold, and merchant blocking can block by merchant, category or merchant ID. These are narrow fraud and authorization controls, not a general rule engine for user-defined event-to-action automation. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule builder with configurable triggers and actions, documentation of how rules are defined (UI or API), breadth beyond 3DS and merchant blocking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
